stem: Dense-forests on the earth are mostly found –
expl: Dense forests on the Earth are mainly found near the Equator. Tropical evergreen rainforests extend near the Equator, between 10° North and 10° South latitudes. These forests are very dense. They are spread over three major regions of the world— Amazon Basin—Brazil, Bolivia, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, French Guiana, Guyana, and Suriname. Congo Basin—Republic of the Congo, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea, and Democratic Republic of the Congo. Borneo–Mekong, South-east Asia Basin—This includes Borneo Island and the Mekong River basin. China, Myanmar, Thailand, Laos, Cambodia, etc. are included under it. Therefore, option (a) is the correct answer.

stem: The main soil that develops in the coniferous forest regions of the Taiga is -
expl: The soil developed in the coniferous forest regions of the Taiga is called Podzol soil. It is formed through the process of podzolization. It is found in most parts of Canada, Alaska, and the former Soviet Union.

stem: Which of the following tribal communities belongs to the negrito race?
expl: The Negrito race is considered one of the most ancient racial groups. In India, some tribes of this race live in South India. The Great Andamanese, Onge, and Sentinelese of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are included in this race.

stem: Which of the following human races inhabitates in China, Mangolia and Japan ?
expl: China, Mongolia, and Japan are mainly inhabited by people of the Mongoloid race. The Australoid race is native to Melanesia and Australia. The Negro race is native to the African continent. The Nordic race is native to North-Western and Northern Europe, and is found in countries such as Iceland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Poland, and western Russia, etc.
